note: The page calls setLayoutProperty on load to give country labels a two-line `format` text-field: the English name at 1.2 scale, a newline, and the local name at 0.8 in a different font. A layout property has no history, so the fixture writes the same value into the same layer and draws the same frame. It names `label_country_1` rather than the page's `label_country`, because bright splits its country labels by rank and has no layer of that name -- run as written against today's bright, the page's own call would find nothing.
